goal: Apply SPADE to the real CosyVoice 2 (0.5B) LLM-TTS backbone: WER-based layer importance (WLI) pruning of its 24-layer Qwen2 LLM plus adaptive multi-level distillation recovery on a small real-audio dataset, with Whisper-WER / RTF / parameter evaluation.
stack: python (torch 2.9 + 2x NVIDIA L4 24GB; CosyVoice upstream repo + CosyVoice2-0.5B checkpoint)

requirement_alignment.source: Derived from user request ('先做CosyVoice2') + the SPADE paper (CosyVoice2 rows of Table 1: 24 -> 12/9 layers) + inspection of the official CosyVoice repo (Qwen2LM wraps Qwen2ForCausalLM; llm.pt/flow.pt/hift.pt checkpoint; parquet data pipeline).
requirement_alignment.goal: Runnable SPADE-on-CosyVoice2 integration: load the official checkpoint, compute WLI over LLM layers, prune 24->12, distill with the SPADE composite loss on a small real dataset, and evaluate WER/RTF/params before and after.
non_goals: Full reproduction of the paper's 7-epoch LibriTTS-scale run (limited to a small demo subset here)
DPO / GRPO, streaming inference, TRT/JIT export, CosyVoice 3
Pruning flow/hift (paper prunes only the LLM backbone)
user_visible_behavior: Setup script that prepares the CosyVoice repo, Python deps, and pretrained checkpoint
CLI stages: prepare-data, prune-llm, wli, distill, evaluate (under spade_cosyvoice2/)
WLI report for all 24 LLM layers + pruned checkpoint + distilled checkpoint
README section documenting the CosyVoice2 pipeline
constraints: Must not modify the upstream CosyVoice repo; integration lives in the SPADE repo and imports CosyVoice via PYTHONPATH
Keep demo data small (LibriTTS dev-clean subset, ~54MB) so the whole flow runs on 2x L4
Pruning touches only the Qwen2 layer stack; all other LLM modules (text encoder, embeddings, decoder) are copied
risks: CosyVoice upstream code/API drift vs the paper's version (pinned at download time)
Speech-tokenizer / campplus onnx runtime issues (onnxruntime CPU/GPU providers)
WLI cost: 24 layers x eval subset x (TTS synth + Whisper) -- controlled via small eval subset
Model download from hf-mirror was failing; using modelscope (verified ~2MB/s)
acceptance_checks: Zero-shot inference synthesizes audio with the official checkpoint
Pruned 12-layer LLM loads and synthesizes; params/depth reduced
WLI report computed over the 24 LLM layers on an eval subset
Distillation improves WER vs the pruned model on the eval subset
requirement_alignment.validation_approach: Stage-level runs on the real checkpoint + existing pytest suite; final numbers recorded in a report JSON
requirement_alignment.first_iteration_scope: spade_cosyvoice2/ package skeleton + setup script + docs; verify checkpoint loads and zero-shot inference works
follow_up_iterations: Data prep (LibriTTS dev-clean -> parquet with embeddings + speech tokens)
LLM pruning (24->12) via state-dict remap + inference check
WLI computation on the real model
assumptions: User wants the paper's CosyVoice2 experiment (LLM depth pruning + distillation) runnable in this environment
Prune only the LLM Qwen2 layers; flow/hift untouched
Small real dataset (LibriTTS dev-clean subset) is acceptable for a demo run; scaling knobs documented
WLI uses Whisper ASR WER on synthesized audio, per the paper
GitHub issues/PRs on ml-inory/SPADE are authorized (previous run established)
open_questions: Target depth 12 vs 9 (paper reports both) -- default 12, configurable

issues.title: feat[cv2-1]: CosyVoice2 integration skeleton, setup script, and smoke inference
acceptance_checks: spade_cosyvoice2/ package exists with path/config helpers
setup.sh prepares CosyVoice upstream, Python deps, and downloads CosyVoice2-0.5B (modelscope, with HF fallback)
smoke.py loads CosyVoice2 and synthesizes one zero-shot utterance to a wav (exit 0)

rounds.test_summary: 38 existing tests pass; smoke.py exit 0 with a 6.24s synthesized wav on the official CosyVoice2-0.5B checkpoint (2x L4)
rounds.implementation_summary: Scaffolded spade_cosyvoice2/ with path helpers, a one-shot setup script (CosyVoice upstream + deps + modelscope/HF checkpoint download), shared model/data utils, and a smoke CLI. Worked around a torchaudio 2.9/torchcodec breakage by patching cosyvoice load_wav to soundfile.
